candidate_windows.window_text: We use the STARCODER 16B and code-davinci-002 (CODEX) models to generate Python programs. We set the sampling temperature to 0.7 for both models. For every question, we generate five model predictions and select the candidate with the highest log probability. We include five shots in the prompt for WikiTQ, HiTab, and Spider datasets, and eight shots for the AIT dataset.
